Definition: Whether the digital ID is recognized or interoperable across borders through regional agreements or travel documents
Comments: No evidence of formal cross-border recognition or regional interoperability for South Sudan's national ID. The EAC immigration page lists only Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda as using national IDs as travel documents between each other; South Sudan is not included. The World Bank EAC mutual recognition study (2018) found South Sudan's ID system at early stage without cross-border recognition. No formal interoperability agreement found.
